subject.title: fix(discord): pass session file to plugin slash commands

question: Should Discord native plugin command dispatch use the transcript facade for legacy `sessionFile`, or may this PR intentionally add direct session-store/file-path calls during the storage migration?
rationale: The code fix is mechanically clear, but accepting a transition-only storage helper in a runtime command path is a compatibility and migration ownership choice.

options.title: Use the transcript facade
options.body: Replace the direct store load, entry resolution, and file persistence calls with `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget`, then refresh the focused test and live proof.

options.title: Accept a temporary storage exception
options.body: Maintainers could explicitly allow this Discord path to use transition-only helpers if they document why it is exempt from the accessor migration.

options.title: Keep the draft blocked
options.body: Leave the PR waiting until the contributor provides a facade-based revision and real Discord proof, or close later under stale draft policy if it stays inactive long enough.

recommendation.title: Use the transcript facade
recommendation.body: Replace the direct store load, entry resolution, and file persistence calls with `resolveSessionTranscriptLegacyFileTarget`, then refresh the focused test and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent session transcript/accessor migration and deprecation path this PR intersects.
